pages.title: sk
pages.summary: sk is a self-hosted engine for governed workflows: describe the work in plain language, approve what it may touch, and every run is recorded.

pages.title: sk CLI reference
pages.summary: Every sk command and argument — and the surface authoring runs through: creating or changing a workflow, connector, knowledge source or skill is a definition edit, and definition edits belong here, where the change is a file you can read and a command you can re-run.

pages.title: Connector & recipe catalog
